quote: Norman L. Gilbreath who, in 1958, presented it to the mathematical community after observing the pattern by chance while doing arithmetic on a napkin.
note: François Proth published identical observations in 1878, eighty years before Gilbreath's discovery, but the conjecture is formally attributed to Gilbreath's 1958 presentation.
